I run a lot of mods and a few might be changing weapon stats, but not to the extent of making this weapon essentially have no changed stats.

When swapping between the 3.9 black and bronze slides, the bronze slide is slightly to the rear, or the black slide is slightly forward.

There might be more going on, but this is what I’ve found.
